segments.text: It looks like one of the stuffed animal that Rin gave Primula, but it has a will for some reason.
Its driving force is Lisianthus' hope and compassion
It looks like one of the stuffed animal that Rin gave Primula, but it has a will for some reason.
Its driving force is Nerine's love and Lycoris' kindness
It looks like the stuffed animal that Lycoris gave Primula, but it has a will for some reason.
This stuffed animal was given to Limes by Raito, at the end of Limes' route, it got its own will, presumably from being close to Limes's magic power.
Kirara's younger twin sister.
Raito's mother. She works developing medical devices that use magic. Due to her work she spends most of the time overseas.

Raito's father. He and other passengers mysteriously disappeared seven years ago during a plane flight. They were all presumed dead in the incident, but their bodies and the wreckage were never found.

Kohaku's father. He and other passengers inexplicably vanished on an airplane trip seven years ago. They were all assumed perished as a result of the incident, but their bodies and the aircraft were never discovered.

Kohaku's mother. She and other passengers inexplicably vanished on an airplane trip seven years ago. They were all assumed perished as a result of the incident, but their bodies and the aircraft were never discovered.

Sia, for short; she is the only daughter of the King of the Gods. The single memory of her childhood meeting with Rin has brought her to the Human world. Bright and energetic, her outgoing personality lets her talk at ease with anyone she meets and quickly sets the mood in conversation. She is good at housework and sports, but studying isn't her forte. She is also known to beat her father with a chair from time to time if he gets out of control.
from MangaGamer

Rin, for short, is the only daughter of the King of the Devils. Like Lisianthus, the memories of her childhood with Rin have brought her to the Human world. She is proper, modest, and reserved, but she won't hesitate to release her offensive magic when someone makes a fool out of Rin. She also possesses a beautiful voice, dubbed "Angel's Bell," but she dislikes singing.
In her route's sequel, Tick Tack!, Nerine can be potentially subjected to changes in personality, physical features, and memory due to Rin's interference in the past era before her birth.
from MangaGamer
A boy who appears in a lot of Navel and Basil games, and mischievously lifts the skirts of the heroines.
adapted from Danbooru Wiki
Princess of the Gods race.
Lithia's a kind-hearted girl but holds a negative view of humans after her great-aunt's death, suggesting that "humans are nothing but trouble for the divine race."
Eventually, she aims to succeed her father, Kunzite, as the lord of the divine realm and to bring happiness to all.
Likes: motivated individuals, cute things, sunflowers
Dislikes: dishonesty, irrationality
Translated and edited from the official website

In Princess x Princess, Lithia and Raito are officially dating. The days of strained diplomatic relations and regular deduction of points are gone, and now they have built a sweet relationship. She enjoys her sweet one-on-one relationship with Raito, but her ideal future is to live a prosperous life like her parents with the practice of polygamy.
Her real name is Trifane, while the name Lithia was given to her by her great-aunt.

The second princess of the Demon World. Her full name is Carnelian; however, since it's too lengthy, people around prefer to call her "Nelia." Since she was a child, she has been acquainted with Lithia.
While she is normally a perfectionist model student, she flips a switch and becomes a total seductress whenever Raito is around.

Her original plan was pure spite: she intended to steal the human the Divine Princess was obsessed with, seduce him, and then ruthlessly dump him. Instead, the plan backfired, and she fell for him the moment they met. Now she has to constantly fight her own feelings, telling herself, "I'm only here to make him fall for me so I can break his heart," just to stay the course.
Likes:
adoptive
grandmother, singing
Dislikes: mankind, the human world
Translated and edited from the official website
Her name comes from Carnelian, a brownish-red gemstone.
A junior who is enrolled in the same drama club as Kohaku. She is in the C-class in the first year.
Kirara is a human world enthusiast who was born in the god world and raised in the demon world.
She joined the drama club because of her admiration for Kohaku but is now beginning to develop her talent as a screenwriter.
She does not dislike Raito (in fact, she likes him), but at the moment she is too occupied with the performance at the festival to spare time for him.
Motto: "One rotten apple spoils the barrel."
Likes: the human world, humans, fashion, good-looking people, Kohaku-senpai
Dislikes: people who say badly about their parents or hometown.
Translated and edited from the official website
Raito's elder cousin. They currently share an apartment.
Kohaku considers Raito her younger brother since they grew up as siblings. She believes her feeling for him is "family love."
An honor student, Kohaku leads the school's theater club and is ambitious, yet she is sloppy at home and has trouble getting up in the morning. Raito typically cleans her room and helps her wake up.
Likes: Raito's cooking, the sun
Dislikes: Waking up in the morning, clock alarm
Translated and edited from the official website
A mysterious girl.
She seems to have emotions but lacks expressiveness.
Likes: Nothing notable
Dislikes: Nothing notable
Translated from the official website
Her full name is Limestone, but people around prefer to call her "Limes".
She looks pretty young at first glance, however, she's only a year younger than Raito.
A student from Verbena Academy enrolled in class 2A. Raito shares an apartment in Kongo Town with his cousin, Anjou Kohaku.

While most might crave excitement, Raito is an exception, cherishing the predictability of a monotonous routine above all else. In stark contrast to his laid-back cousin, Kohaku, Raito willingly shoulders the daily responsibilities of housework and cooking for the two of them.
Rather than immersing himself in club activities, Raito's post-school hours are typically spent meandering through the aisles of a supermarket in the local shopping district.
Likes: Tranquil days, the comfort of monotony, culinary activities.
Dislikes: Impulsiveness, being misunderstood.
Translated and edited from the official website
"The Intellectual Chivalrous God-King"

Under the reign of the current Divine King, Kunzite, there's a distinct vibe of harmony and a kind of old-school chivalry, reminiscent of the honor-bound code of the Yakuza. This is a sharp departure from Eusthoma's more muscle-flexing, power-based approach. Despite their different leadership styles, Kunzite and Eusthoma have one key thing in common - they're both total softies when it comes to their daughters.
"Ah, you've got an interest in that girl? You've got good taste. Seems like you and I might see eye to eye. How about it? Fancy joining me for a drink?"
Likes: Daughter, wives, friends, Shimizu Jirocho
Dislikes: Foolishness
Translated and edited from the official website
"The Timid Papa Demon King"
The current Demon King.

Unlike Forbessi, Chalcedony is more of a muscle-bound powerhouse type. His formidable body and stern face might look intimidating, but he's actually quite humble and a bit on the timid side. Chalcedony's a devoted dad, always giving it his all to look after his sickly wife. And, just like Forbessi, he's a complete softie when it comes to his wife and daughter.
"Whew, you had me worried there~. For a second, Papa didn't know what was going to happen..."
Likes: Daughters, wife, friends, housework
Dislikes: Corruption, conspiracies
Translated and edited from the official website
"The Charismatic Pervert."

Torajirou, the student council president, is not just a classmate but also a close confidant of Raito. He possesses a trio of attributes that make him stand out—striking good looks, a sharp intellect, and athletic prowess.

At a glance, Torajirou presents himself as the quintessential diligent student. But beneath this polished exterior lies a naughty side. He frequently succumbs to lecherous glances at girls and often can't resist making inappropriate comments. Yet, he's adept at keeping this side of him under wraps, revealing his true colors only in Raito's presence.
"Why don't you take my hand, Raito? Life’s never boring with me."
Likes: Ladies of all ages, admirers
Dislikes: Men, haters
Translated and edited from the official website

Drawing parallels to a previous character, Torajirou shares many similarities in appearance and disposition with Midoriba Itsuki. However, a notable divergence exists. While Itsuki was open about his flirtatious tendencies, Torajirou masks his, leading many to perceive him as just another regular, if not excellent, student.
She is a junior and Kirara's classmate.
Although she was a childhood friend of Kirara when she lived in Demon World, she came to the human world earlier.
Despite being a demon, she is exceptionally knowledgeable about the human world. She often corrects Kirara's biased understanding of the mortal realm. (Kirara is not listening, though)
Citrine is a hyper-realist and has a solid plan for the future.
Her hobbies are part-time work and saving money.
She works part-time at Cafe Bismuth and has several other part-time jobs.
According to Raito, while she looks greedy and believes that "time is money," she is also a discerning individual, unwilling to take up other people's time.
Citrine loves playing RPGs as the gameplay involves grows steadily by accumulating experience. She also has a hobby of learning game-style offensive magic but does not have a chance to use it.
Likes: facts, reality, part-time jobs, offensive magic
Dislikes: working for free
Translated and edited from the official website
Raito's classmate and a god-human hybrid.

Notably busty, Marine always appears sleepy and distant, yet her academic performance is surprisingly strong. Also known as the information hub of the school, most of the scoop can be had just by asking her. The disparity between her lethargic appearance and her prowess in both academics and information gathering leaves her peers perplexed. Marine chalks it all up to her sleep-learning skills.
She has a devil-may-care personality and usually fools around. Still, she can be reliable in times of need.
"I just absorb all kinds of info in my sleep~♪"
Likes: Sleep, teasing others
Dislikes: None notable
Translated and edited from the official website
The homeroom teacher of Raito's class.

While Menou maintains a relaxed atmosphere in her class, she expects her students not to abuse the liberty she grants them. Failing to uphold this responsibility can lead to her becoming surprisingly strict.
"I mostly let the students do their own thing~"
Likes: Students, autonomy, minimal interference
Dislikes: Hot-blooded teacher drama, regulations
Translated and edited from the official website
Menou corresponds to Nadeshiko's position from the prequel, but their characters are the opposite.
Fluora is a maid born in a family of servants who have served the God-world's royal family for generations. She currently acts as Lithia's caretaker and bodyguard.
She is a hard-working maid capable of getting things done, yet she lacks initiative.
Since she takes care of everything around the household, Lithia is a little bad at housework and cooking. Fluora feels responsible for this but can do nothing about it.
Likes: cleaning, cooking
Dislikes: shopping, calculation, planning
Translated and edited from the official website
Before becoming a royal guard, she used to belong to the Intelligence Bureau of the Divine Realm. Rumor has it that she and the deputy director of the Intelligence Bureau are on bad terms.
A butler of the Devil royal family who graduated as the top class from the servant department of the Royal University of the Demon World. Also known as 'Gentleman's Gentleman.'

Alexander is a servant among servants who can handle any task perfectly. He has been taking care of Nelia and her sister since childhood. Some demons who don't know the circumstances may see him as a potential brother-in-law for Nelia, but in reality, he is attracted to men (although it's said that he may also be attracted to women at times).
He is also interested in Raito, but instead of pursuing him romantically, he tends to fantasize about Raito's relationships with other men, which is becoming problematic.
Likes: Boys who seem to shine if polished
Dislikes: Boredom
Translated and edited from the official website
"The Girl Who Lives for Eternity"
Primula is an ultimate homunculus, a synthesis of both Divine and Demonic best essences.

A century has gracefully lapsed since her initial introduction, yet time seems to have left an untouched, youthful countenance upon her. With a discerning eye, one can perceive the subtle maturation she has undergone. Nevertheless, the emotional vibrancy acquired from her dedicated route in prior adventure persists, now imbued with an added layer of wisdom.

Revered as a living legend, her stature and influence surpass even the current God and Devil Kings. Although the Devil World is her current primary abode, she frequently visits the other realms, furthering her vital responsibilities within an organization that oversees significant matters spanning the three realms. She's also the guardian of Limes.
As Primula interacts with Raito, the current protagonist, she sees shades of Rin in him.

"Once, I found expressing my emotions elusive. My power would spiral when my heart wavered. Yet, during my time in the human world, alongside cherished friends, I uncovered a tapestry of feelings. It stabilized me. A century has passed, but with eyes closed, it still feels like yesterday."
Likes: Cats, cheesecake, former friends
Dislikes: Loneliness
Based on the official website and Princess x Princess page
